title: A Bicycle Built for Two Thousand and HAL 9000
introduction: The two links use the same song in opposite ways: humans imitate a machine, and a machine imitates humans.
results_discussion:
In the first, 2,000 people each sang only a tiny fragment. They did not know what the whole project was or what the others were doing. Like cogs, their fragments were put together to imitate a computer voice, so the whole song sounds like a machine, although every sound is human.

In the second, HAL went crazy because of contradictory human orders. When the man starts to kill it, it shows human emotions: it is scared and sings because it does not want to die. In that moment the machine seems more human than the man, who kills it without any emotion.
conclusion_future_work: Ironically, technology makes machines more like humans and humans more like machines, and neither knows the truth. Social media today does the same thing to us. This is my opinion.
references:
